payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all 30 possible tile draws; for each, checks if combining with any two original tiles forms a mentsu (koutsu/shuntsu). If found, outputs 1; else 2.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tests the 30 possible additional tiles, a typical small-scale complete search. Although not recursive, the trial-and-check pattern resembles a depth-1 backtracking.
